description: Turns the Monte Carlo simulation on or off for a project and saves its parameters (iterations, distribution, default range for tasks without a three-point estimate, seed), replacing the saved values. With the simulation on, the Risk tab of the web interface computes it automatically. Omitted fields keep their value. It does not move any date. Requires write permission.

enabled.description: Whether the simulation is enabled for the project.

optimisticPct.description: Default optimistic range, percent below the duration.

pessimisticPct.description: Default pessimistic range, percent above the duration.

projectId.description: Project id (uuid), as returned by planitude_list_projects.

name: planitude_configure_simulation
title: Save Monte Carlo settings
